# Velcro

> Instant crypto onramp and offramp platform in Nigeria and Africa, powering direct Naira-to-crypto swaps, merchant payment links, and dedicated digital asset storefronts.

Velcro enables individuals and merchants to buy, sell, and settle cryptocurrency (USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH, SOL) using Nigerian bank transfers with sub-3-minute automated execution.

## Core Products & Services
- [Velcro Ramp](https://ramp.usevelcro.com/): Instant crypto onramp and offramp for USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH, and SOL with direct bank settlement.
- [Merchant Portal](https://merchant.usevelcro.com/): Self-service merchant portal to launch custom exchange storefronts, manage margins, and accept payments.
- [Merchant Storefronts](https://ramp.usevelcro.com/m/): White-label branded swap pages hosted on custom subdomains.
- [API Health & Status](https://ramp.usevelcro.com/api/health): Real-time backend system status, database connectivity, and poller health.
